lines.text: This new song is a banger!

data.define: A very good song that gets people moving.

example.text: This new song is a banger!

misuse.text: Don't call a quiet lullaby a 'banger'.
misuse.why: It means an energetic, great song.

data.l1_hook: Bu şarkıyı daha yüksek sesle çal, 'banger'!
